description: This file defines the SettingsActivity class for the Android app, providing a TV-friendly interface to configure game difficulty and speed settings. It manages UI interactions, loads and saves settings via SettingsRepository, and handles key events.

classes.name: SettingsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity providing a settings UI for game difficulty and speed, with persistence and key event handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, loads current settings, populates UI spinners, and sets button click handlers.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles the back key press to finish the activity.
